tasks.subject: Clean up pytest cache artifacts
tasks.description: Remove stale .pytest_cache/lastfailed file and clear cached test results. The lastfailed file records 10 old test failures that no longer apply since all 1133 tests currently pass. Ensure no test artifacts remain that could confuse future runs.
tasks.output: Successfully removed stale pytest cache artifacts (lastfailed file). All 1133 tests pass cleanly afterward.

tasks.subject: Verify pytest test suite passes cleanly
tasks.description: Run python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short and confirm 1133 tests pass with zero failures. Verify the .pytest_cache/v/cache/lastfailed file is properly cleared after running. Document the test run results.
tasks.output: All 1133 tests pass cleanly. pytest test suite verification complete. No failures. The .pytest_cache/lastfailed artifacts were successfully removed and no longer contain stale failure data.
